name: Message type
description: What this alert message does, using the same codes as CAP 1.2 (OASIS). An update or cancel message must point back to the alert it replaces, or people will see the old and new warning side by side.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Alert
hasDefinedTerm.description: Shares new information about a situation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Update
hasDefinedTerm.description: Replaces an earlier alert with new information.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Acknowledgement
hasDefinedTerm.description: Confirms an earlier message was received.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Error
hasDefinedTerm.description: Reports that a message was rejected.
